Vehicle.wheels:
# a family car: wheelbase 2.6 m, track 1.6 m
defaults: radius=0.35 rest=0.3 travel=0.2 spring=35000 damper=3200 grip=1.2
fl: -0.8 -0.15 -1.3 steer=1 brake=1 entity=21
fr: 0.8 -0.15 -1.3 steer=1 brake=1 entity=22
rl: -0.8 -0.15 1.3 drive=1 brake=0.7 handbrake=1 entity=23
rr: 0.8 -0.15 1.3 drive=1 brake=0.7 handbrake=1 entity=24

InputMap.bindings:
throttle = w, arrowup, gamepad.rt
reverse = s, arrowdown, gamepad.lt
steer = d, arrowright, a:-1, arrowleft:-1, gamepad.lx
handbrake = space, gamepad.a
reset = r, gamepad.y

Text.value: W drive   S brake, then reverse   A D steer   Space handbrake   R put the car back

systems.name: drive
systems.doc: The pedals and the wheel: the actions of the `InputMap` become the car's controls.

systems.name: reset
systems.doc: R puts the car back on the start line, upright and still.

systems.name: car_status
systems.doc: What the HUD and the camera need to know about the car.

systems.name: chase
systems.doc: The camera swings round behind the car, the short way.

systems.name: gate_passed
systems.doc: Driving through a gate counts it and takes the gate down. Cones and crates are on another layer: they never set a gate off.
